insights.finding: Returns erase profit on a large share of returned orders
insights.evidence: $71,474 of profit lost across 1,000 returns; 1,000 returns (100.0%) end below zero profit
insights.action: Review the return policy for the items with the largest losses and set a restocking fee this week

insights.finding: Fashion is the category with the largest profit lost
insights.action: Check quality, description and sizing issues in Fashion and tighten its return terms

insights.finding: A visible group of returns is flagged as suspected abuse
insights.evidence: 192 of 1,000 returns (19.2%) carry the flag and account for $16,241 (22.7% of profit lost)
insights.action: Send the flagged returns to manual review before refunds are paid

insights.finding: 'Changed mind' is the most costly return reason
insights.action: Fix the cause behind this reason in listings or packaging and report it again next week

insights.finding: Shipping and handling take a measurable part of returned order value
insights.evidence: Handling and shipping equal 35.2% of returned order value ($28,088 of $79,901); 689 returns cost over a quarter of their value
insights.action: Renegotiate the return carrier rate and steer high-cost returns to drop-off

insights.finding: Many returned items bring back almost none of their cost
insights.evidence: 260 of 1,000 returns (26.0%) recover under 20% of item cost
insights.action: Route low recovery items to vendor credit or liquidation instead of restocking

insights.finding: Accounts with repeated returns carry a disproportionate loss
insights.evidence: 723 returns (72.3%) come from accounts with 3+ returns and hold 71.1% of profit lost
insights.action: Contact these accounts about fit and expectations and watch their next orders

insights.finding: Statistically unusual returns hold more loss than their count suggests
insights.evidence: 50 unusual returns (5.0%) account for 12.1% of profit lost
insights.action: Review the unusual returns list in the dashboard on Monday

insights.finding: The abuse model separates flagged from unflagged returns on unseen rows
insights.evidence: Held-out AUC 0.92 (above the naive 0.50); strongest signal: Item_Condition
insights.action: Use the score to order the review queue, not to decide refunds on its own

insights.finding: Return label fees are often waived
insights.evidence: 555 of 1,000 returns (55.5%) were charged no label fee
insights.action: Decide which return reasons should still carry a fee and apply it from next week

insights.finding: Australia has the highest average loss per return
insights.action: Review shipping and return terms for Australia
